questions.question: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit to the right of X. Only two people sit between X and Q. questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(44, 52, 18)

(50, 56, 22)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** **Second Number = (First Number − Third Number) × 2**.

For, **(44, 52, 18)**

⇒ 44 − 18 = 26

⇒ 26 × 2 = 52

For, **(50, 56, 22)**

⇒ 50 − 22 = 28

⇒ 28 × 2 = 56

questions.question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

517 520 525 532 541 ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The differences between the terms are consecutive odd numbers: 3, 5, 7, 9.

Next odd number in the sequence after 9 is 11.

Required number = 541 + 11 = 552.

**∴ The correct answer is 552.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given series: 517, 520, 525, 532, 541, ?

Pattern: Addition of consecutive odd numbers to the previous term.

517 +3 → 520 +5 → 525 +7 → 532 +9 → 541 +11 → 552

Pattern explanation: The difference between consecutive terms follows the sequence of odd numbers: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, ...

⇒ 517 + 3 = 520

⇒ 520 + 5 = 525

⇒ 525 + 7 = 532

⇒ 532 + 9 = 541

⇒ 541 + 11 = 552

**∴ The correct answer is 552.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Odd Number Series

A sequence where terms are generated by adding consecutive odd integers (1, 3, 5, 7, ...) to previous terms.

Prime Number Series

A common variation where the differences are consecutive prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ...).

Double Difference Series

In these series, the difference of the differences (second-level difference) remains constant or follows a specific pattern.

questions.question: Preethi ranked 6th from the top and 12th from the bottom in her class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Total number of students = (Position of a person from the top + Position of the same person from the bottom) − 1**

Given:

Rank from Top = 6

Rank from Bottom = 12

Total students = 6 + 12 − 1

Total students = 18 − 1

Total students = 17

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
